description: Continuously attack a target entity using the pvp plugin (pathfinds into range and keeps swinging). Resolves when the target dies or is lost. Long-running and cancellable. Provide an entityId, or a `target` filter (type/name/username) to pick the nearest match.

attackRange.description: How close the bot must be to attack

entityId.description: Entity network id (obtain from list_entities / find_nearest_entity)

followRange.description: How close to get when pursuing the target

target.description: Filter used to pick the nearest matching entity when entityId is omitted

name: pvp_attack
